transform.sql: SELECT PI_LDE.DATETIME as DATETIME, PD_LDC_LATEST.MP_BLADE as MP_BLADE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_READ_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_RANDOM_READ_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_WRITE_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_RANDOM_WRITE_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_READ_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_SEQUENTIAL_READ_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_IO_RATE, SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_READ_IO_RATE) + SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_WRITE_IO_RATE) + SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_READ_IO_RATE) + SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_IO_RATE) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_TOTAL_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_READ_XFER_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_RANDOM_READ_XFER_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_WRITE_XFER_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_RANDOM_WRITE_XFER_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_READ_XFER_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_SEQUENTIAL_READ_XFER_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_XFER_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_XFER_RATE, SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_READ_XFER_RATE) + SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_WRITE_XFER_RATE) + SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_READ_XFER_RATE) + SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_XFER_RATE) AS SUM_OF_LDEV_TOTAL_XFER_RATE FROM PI_LDE JOIN PD_LDC_LATEST ON PI_LDE.LDEV_NUMBER = PD_LDC_LATEST.LDEV_NUMBER GROUP BY PD_LDC_LATEST.MP_BLADE, PI_LDE.DATETIME;
